messages.subject: Re: NBLAST Running Advice
parts:
Dear Amanda,

Thanks for your enquiry. It looks like you are trying to run NBLAST with
a mixture of python and R. I cannot really diagnose without more details
of your code than you provide below. However these days I would
generally recommend that you use either the pure R or pure python
implementations. Philipp Schlegel in the group maintains a very complete
python implementation in navis which should not depend on ay R code. If
you prefer python this is probably the way to go.

All the best,

Greg.
